summary: Our AI-powered railway inspection system detects track defects, bridge damage, and obstacles using computer vision (YOLOv11/R-CNN). Awarded 2nd Runner Up in Wabtec's Exceed 3.0 Hackathon, it prevents accidents and reduces India's ₹300cr annual rail losses. The solution enables predictive maintenance
